segments.line: You're dreaming you can fly. Suddenly, your little
sister drops from the sky riding a giant goldfish.
Because her bedroom is three meters away.
Next night, Mo sleeps on your floor. Your dream becomes
a laser battle with infinite pizza.
Third night, you walk into your secret dream vault. And your sister
is standing there reading your diary.
What if dreams were multiplayer? The
rule: you share a dream with whoever is sleeping physically closest to you. At first, it's the
ultimate co- op game.
Sleepovers become superhero movies. You build entire worlds before breakfast.
Until you take an overnight red- eye flight. In REM sleep, your
amygdala fires thirty percent hotter than when awake, while
your brainstem paralyzes your muscles. That's real. Inside
a cabin six meters wide, two hundred
passengers enter REM sleep together. One person has a
nightmare. And
the terror infects the entire plane. Two hundred
strangers trapped in one monster, unable
to scream, unable to wake up. When you
land, men in dark suits seal the gate. They know what happened. And
tonight, your little sister just fell asleep next door with a fever. And
the walls are starting to melt. Part one.
